title: Physics-Informed Implicit Neural Representations for Improved Myocardial Perfusion MRI Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2608.11282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantifying myocardial perfusion from cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) can be achieved by fitting tracer-kinetic models to the dynamic contrast-enhanced MR data. However, fitting the observed data with multi-compartment exchange models, which describe the evolution of the contrast agent in the tissue, to estimate perfusion parameters is a challenging inverse problem that is sensitive to noise and acquisition variability. Previously, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have been proposed as an alternative to conventional non-linear least squares fitting methods with promising results for quantitative perfusion CMR. In this work, we extend the previously proposed PINN framework with spatiotemporal implicit neural representations (INRs) to represent the MR signal as a continuous spatiotemporal function and to improve the accuracy, smoothness, and physical consistency of the PINN model. translated_title: 物理信息隐式神经表示用于改进心肌灌注MRI定量分析
translated_abstract: 从心脏磁共振（CMR）中定量心肌灌注可以通过将示踪剂动力学模型拟合到动态对比增强MR数据来实现。然而，使用多室交换模型（描述对比剂在组织中的演化）拟合观测数据以估计灌注参数是一个具有挑战性的逆问题，该问题对噪声和采集变异性敏感。此前，物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已被提出作为传统非线性最小二乘拟合方法的替代方案，在定量灌注CMR中显示出有前景的结果。在本工作中，我们将先前提出的PINN框架扩展为时空隐式神经表示（INRs），以将MR信号表示为连续的时空函数，并提高PINN模型的准确性、平滑性和物理一致性。在真实模拟的CMR数据集中，我们提出的方法...
tldr: 本文通过引入时空隐式神经表示扩展了物理信息神经网络框架，将MR信号建模为连续时空函数，从而提升了心肌灌注MRI定量的准确性、平滑性和物理一致性。
en_tdlr: This work extends the physics-informed neural network framework with spatiotemporal implicit neural representations to model MR signals as continuous spatiotemporal functions, improving the accuracy, smoothness, and physical consistency of myocardial perfusion MRI quantification.
